dct_description_sm:
Brampton Plan, Schedule “11” Precinct Plan Areas identify specific locations within Brampton that require a more detailed level of planning to guide future development, redevelopment, or intensification. Precinct Plans establish area-specific policies and frameworks for land use, urban design, transportation, infrastructure, public spaces, environmental features, and community services to ensure growth occurs in a coordinated and comprehensive manner. These plans implement the broader objectives of Brampton Plan while responding to the unique opportunities and constraints of each area.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
